options.name: Deck of Seasons
options.description:
If enabled, the sub-gods are drawn from a deck which contains each season exactly once. Duplicates will not appear until a random option is chosen, or the deck runs out.
If disabled, the sub-gods will be selected at random. (default: true)

options.name: Season Length
options.description: The number of turns that normally pass before a new Noble takes their turn. (default: 80)

options.name: Natural Draft Size
options.description: The number of sub-gods that you get to choose from when naturally transitioning from one sub-god to another. (default: 3)

options.name: Selection Draft Size
options.description: The number of sub-gods that you get to choose from when using a power to change from one sub-god to another. (default: 3)

options.name: Enable: Painter of Winds
options.description:
A Fey Noble who spreads darkness and chaos from place to place on the currents of wind. (default: 1)
 0 - Not enabled
1 - Enabled
2 - Only appears randomly
3 - Only appears if selected

options.name: Enable: Lord of the Feast
options.description:
A Fey Noble who bolsters humanity, makes them more aggressive, and manipulates them into ruin. (default: 1)
 0 - Not enabled
1 - Enabled
2 - Only appears randomly
3 - Only appears if selected

options.name: Enable: Niece of Blooming Fields
options.description:
A Fey Noble who makes humanity more prosperous through abundant life, drowning humanity in distractions and making them easier to infiltrate. (default: 1)
 0 - Not enabled
1 - Enabled
2 - Only appears randomly
3 - Only appears if selected

options.name: Enable: Patriarch of the Sun
options.description:
A Fey Noble who crushes humanity under sweltering heat, destabilizes them through devastation, and spreads massive wildfires across the land. (default: 1)
 0 - Not enabled
1 - Enabled
2 - Only appears randomly
3 - Only appears if selected

options.name: Enable: Uncle of the Harvest
options.description:
(NOT CURRENTLY IMPLEMENTED) A Fey Noble whose agents harvest Fey Presence from the land and use it to fuel occult rituals. (default: 1)
 0 - Not enabled
1 - Enabled
2 - Only appears randomly
3 - Only appears if selected
